title: Hot Disk AB
content: Hot Disk AB is a Swedish instrumentation company that develops thermal property measurement systems for low-density and highly insulating materials. Its official low-density measurement module is positioned for ultra-low thermal conductivity testing and specifically references aerogels, making the company a relevant equipment supplier for aerogel research, product development, and quality characterization. Hot Disk systems are widely used for measuring thermal conductivity, thermal diffusivity, and related properties in porous insulation materials.
